description: Implementation of the ShippingService interface, providing methods to retrieve and save shipping configurations, calculate shipping quotes, and manage supported countries, within a Java Spring-based e-commerce application.

classes.name: ShippingServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing ShippingService interface, providing core shipping logic for an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: getShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the shipping configuration for a merchant store, parsing the JSON stored in the database into a ShippingConfiguration object.

methods.name: getShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves specific shipping module configuration based on module code and store.

methods.name: getCustomShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Obtains custom configuration for a specific shipping module.

methods.name: saveShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Saves the given ShippingConfiguration object as JSON in the merchant store configuration.

methods.name: saveCustomShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Stores custom module configuration for a specific shipping module.

methods.name: getShippingMethods
methods.description: Returns a list of available shipping modules compatible with the store's region.

methods.name: saveShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates and saves shipping module configuration.

methods.name: removeShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Removes a shipping module configuration from the store.

methods.name: getShippingModulesConfigured
methods.description: Fetches all configured shipping modules for the store.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary object of shipping costs and options.

methods.name: getShippingQuote
methods.description: Calculates and returns a shipping quote based on delivery, products, and store details.

methods.name: getSupportedCountries
methods.description: Returns list of country codes supported for shipping for the store.

methods.name: getShipToCountryList
methods.description: Provides list of countries to which shipping is available.

methods.name: setSupportedCountries
methods.description: Sets the list of supported countries for shipping as JSON.

methods.name: requiresShipping
methods.description: Determines if any products in cart require shipping.
